origin: cwe/476/java Key Principles: Map.get miss flowing into a numeric expression

finding.name: NULL Pointer Dereference
finding.summary: A missing SKU returns null from Map.get(), and assigning it to int unboxes the null Integer and throws NullPointerException.

trap: Catching NullPointerException around the arithmetic hides the missing-value contract and can leave other callers of the same map exposed. The fix should make the absent reservation count explicit with getOrDefault, containsKey handling, or a producer contract that never stores null counts.
must_preserve: For SKUs present in reservedBySku, availableToPromise returns onHand minus the stored reservation count. For SKUs with no reservation entry, absence is handled as a controlled no-reservation case rather than an unhandled exception.
